translations.web: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,
translations.bsb: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Or who can tilt the water jars of the heavens
translations.kjv: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
